chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"A part of me will be buried in the land of Khurasan. No believer will visit her except that Allah will make Paradise obligatory for him and forbid his body from the Fire."

key_terms.النَّارِ: the Fire, from which the visitor’s body is protected
key_terms.بَضْعَةٌ: a part or piece of me, indicating a very close relation to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.خُرَاسَانَ: the land of Khurasan where this burial will take place
key_terms.مُؤْمِنٌ: a believer whose visitation is described here

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of the Prophet’s family member buried in Khurasan?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله speaking of a member of his Ahl al-Bayt who would be buried in Khurasan and of the immense reward for a believing visitor. It emphasizes the spiritual merit of visitation and links devotion to the Prophet’s family with salvation from the Fire and entry into Paradise.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3194 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said:
"A part of me will be buried in the land of Khurasan. No believer will visit it except that Allah (swt) will make Paradise obligatory for them and will forbid their body from the Fire."
